description: This PHP source file defines the AmbiguousSuccessParser class, which extends AbstractParser, and handles parsing of Amazon S3 responses that may return success status code 200 even when errors occur. It manages certain ambiguous success cases and converts them into retryable errors.

classes.name: AmbiguousSuccessParser
classes.description: A parser class for handling ambiguous success responses from AWS S3 that return HTTP 200 status with error conditions, converting certain responses into exceptions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing parser, error parser, and exception class.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the parser, handling ambiguous successes and errors.

methods.name: parseMemberFromStream
methods.description: Delegates parsing of a response member from stream to the underlying parser.
